predecessors.name: Rattanakosin Kingdom (Siam)
predecessors.text: Perlis, separated from Kedah by Siam as 'a separate principality' in 1842

successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: Perlis, among the states whose 'rights of suzerainty' Siam transferred to Britain by the treaty of 10 March 1909

ledger.x: 1842: Siam separates Perlis from Kedah as a separate principality, the year the Kedah sultan is restored without it.
1842: Perlis passes from Siam's direct administration of Kedah (annexed 1821) to a principality of its own.
1842: Perlis is a vassal state of Siam.
1843: Siam appoints Syed Hussain Jamalullail as Raja, founding the line that still reigns.
1909: Siam's suzerainty over Perlis passes to Britain.

wars.name: Perang Musuh Bisik
wars.outcome: The Kedah supporters of Sultan Ahmad Tajuddin fought Siam 'for his restoration from 1830 to 1842'; Kedah was restored under Siamese terms in 1842 and Perlis was made a separate principality.

certainty.note: No page opened gives a boundary for Perlis; the frontier with Kedah and with Siamese Satun is approximate.
